intent.proves: At least one email renders content per recipient, set on itself or its campaign folder.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EmailMarketingEmail e LEFT JOIN EmailMarketingTopFolder tf ON tf.TopFolderId = e.EmailTopFolderId WHERE ISNULL(e.EmailIsTemplate, 0) = 0 AND (e.EmailRecipientSpecificContent = 1 OR tf.TopFolderRecipientSpecificContent = 1)
